scope: All code-block, sourcecode, code, literalinclude, and parsed-literal directives under docs/source.

classifications.compiled: A code sample that builds successfully but is not run by validation.
classifications.executed: A canonical sample or its expected output is built/run and checked on each directly supported target framework.
classifications.pseudocode: An illustrative API fragment with a visible Pseudocode caption; it is not a standalone program or part of the Getting Started copy-paste quickstart.
classifications.configuration-only: Commands, fixture data, or static text/output that is not compiled as C# source.
